Private Function Coded(text As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, out As String
    For i = 1 To Len(text)
        out = out & Hex(AscW(Mid(text, i, 1)) And &HFFFF&) & "."
    Next
    Coded = out
End Function

Private Function Named(wb As Object, ws As Object, text As String) As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.Name = text
    Named = Err.Number
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Application.DisplayAlerts = False
        ws.Delete
        Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    End If
End Function

Private Function Placed(wb As Object, text As String, place As Long) As Long
    Dim ws As Object
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(wb.Worksheets.Count))
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.Name = text
    Placed = Err.Number
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Placed <> 0 Then
        Application.DisplayAlerts = False
        ws.Delete
        Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Else
        ws.Range("A1").Value = place
    End If
End Function

Private Function Found(wb As Object, text As String) As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Found = Coded(wb.Worksheets(text).Name)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then Found = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function NameFound(wb As Object, text As String) As String
    On Error Resume Next
    NameFound = Coded(wb.Names(text).Name) & "=" & Coded(wb.Names(text).RefersTo)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then NameFound = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function Shown(v As Variant) As String
    If IsError(v) Then
        Shown = "E" & CStr(CLng(v))
    Else
        Shown = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Coded(text As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, out As String
    For i = 1 To Len(text)
        out = out & Hex(AscW(Mid(text, i, 1)) And &HFFFF&) & "."
    Next
    Coded = out
End Function

Private Function Placed(wb As Object, text As String, place As Long) As Long
    Dim ws As Object
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(wb.Worksheets.Count))
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.Name = text
    Placed = Err.Number
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Placed <> 0 Then
        Application.DisplayAlerts = False
        ws.Delete
        Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Else
        ws.Range("A1").Value = place
    End If
End Function

Private Function Found(wb As Object, text As String) As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Found = Coded(wb.Worksheets(text).Name)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then Found = "E" & Err.Number

Public Function Marks() As String
    Dim wb As Object, out As String, i As Long, first As String, second As String, ws As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    first = ChrW(233)
    second = ChrW(101) & ChrW(769)
    out = out & Placed(wb, "s1" & first, 11) & ";"
    out = out & Placed(wb, "s1" & second, 12) & ";"
    out = out & Found(wb, "s1" & first) & ";" & Found(wb, "s1" & second) & ";"
    out = out & Placed(wb, "r1" & second, 13) & ";"
    out = out & Placed(wb, "r1" & first, 14) & ";"
    out = out & Found(wb, "r1" & first) & ";"
    out = out & Shown(Application.Evaluate("'r1" & first & "'!A1")) & ";"
    On Error Resume Next
    wb.Names.Add Name:="n1" & first, RefersTo:="=11"
    out = out & Err.Number & ";"
    Err.Clear
    wb.Names.Add Name:="n1" & second, RefersTo:="=12"
    out = out & Err.Number & ";"
    Err.Clear
    wb.Names.Add Name:="f1" & first, RefersTo:="=1"
    On Error GoTo 0
    out = out & NameFound(wb, "n1" & first) & ";" & NameFound(wb, "n1" & second)
    out = out & "|"
    first = ChrW(101) & ChrW(769)
    second = ChrW(69) & ChrW(769)
    out = out & Placed(wb, "s2" & first, 21) & ";"
    out = out & Placed(wb, "s2" & second, 22) & ";"
    out = out & Found(wb, "s2" & first) & ";" & Found(wb, "s2" & second) & ";"
    out = out & Placed(wb, "r2" & second, 23) & ";"
    out = out & Placed(wb, "r2" & first, 24) & ";"
    out = out & Found(wb, "r2" & first) & ";"
    out = out & Shown(Application.Evaluate("'r2" & first & "'!A1")) & ";"
    On Error Resume Next
    wb.Names.Add Name:="n2" & first, RefersTo:="=21"
    out = out & Err.Number & ";"
    Err.Clear
    wb.Names.Add Name:="n2" & second, RefersTo:="=22"
    out = out & Err.Number & ";"
    Err.Clear
    wb.Names.Add Name:="f2" & first, RefersTo:="=2"
    On Error GoTo 0
    out = out & NameFound(wb, "n2" & first) & ";" & NameFound(wb, "n2" & second)
    out = out & "|"
    For i = 1 To wb.Names.Count
        out = out & Coded(wb.Names(i).Name) & "=" & Coded(wb.Names(i).RefersTo) & ","
    Next
    out = out & "|"
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    second = ChrW(101) & ChrW(769)
    ws.Range("B1").Formula = "=f1" & second
    out = out & Err.Number & ";"
    out = out & Shown(ws.Range("B1").Value) & ";" & Coded(ws.Range("B1").Formula) & ","
    Err.Clear
    second = ChrW(69) & ChrW(769)
    ws.Range("B2").Formula = "=f2" & second
    out = out & Err.Number & ";"
    out = out & Shown(ws.Range("B2").Value) & ";" & Coded(ws.Range("B2").Formula) & ","
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.Close False
    Marks = out
End Function
